title: Jamaican-Style Plant-Based 'Chicken' Curry
subtitle: with Steamed Rice
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Cook rice: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins. Fluff the rice with a fork.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, cut the capsicum and celery into 4cm chunks. Combine 1 tsp Caribbean seasoning and 1 tbs olive oil in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the chicken-style strips and toss to coat.

Cook chicken-style strips: Heat a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook chicken-style strips, stirring, for 3-4 mins until golden and heated through. Remove from pan. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the pan over medium heat. Cook capsicum and celery, stirring, for 2-3 mins until starting to soften. Add tomato paste and remaining Caribbean seasoning and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant.

Simmer curry: Add the coconut milk and 80ml (⅓ cup) water to the veggie mixture, season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 8-10 mins until the veggies are tender. Stir in the chicken-style strips, then remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the rice and curry among bowls and enjoy!
Make it spicy: Like your curries hot? Kick up the heat a notch or two with a scattering of chopped fresh chilli or chilli flakes.
